items.description_extra:
Using the Stat Tracer add-on, Niantic planned to award this special variant of the Obsidian anomaly badge to the top 1331 Agents globally if they had opted-in. All of this information was leaked via the event page before Niantic announced it. When the page was finally made public officially, the competition and the medal were removed.

You can read more about it at https://fevgames.net/obsidian-anomaly-medal-details/

The design was upscaled by AI and may therefore not be 100% accurate.
